ms.promise:
The team will establish a communication channel and outline the main project.
・Defined Project Scope: A detailed document outlining the project's goals, deliverables, resources, and constraints.
・Detailed Audit Objectives: A comprehensive list of audit objectives, including specific areas of focus
・Audit Timeline: Includes all key milestones, deadlines, and dependencies for each audit phase.
・Established Communication Channels and Project Management Tools: Creation of dedicated communication channels (e.g., Discord) for internal team discussions, stakeholder communication, and community updates
ms.criteria:
・Project Scope Document: The project scope document is completed
・Validation of Audit Objectives: The audit objectives are defined
・Finalization of Audit Timeline: The timeline is agreed with the auditing team
・Setup of Communication Channels and Project Management Tools: All communication channels are tested and operational
ms.report:
For Milestone 1 we provide an extensive report that covers all parts of the deliverables for Milestone 1:
・Signed Project Scope Document: The report contains the project scope (Section 2) and is signed by auditor and project team (last page)
・Approved Audit Objectives: The audit objective is contained in Section 3
・Confirmed Audit Timeline: The audit timeline is contained in Section 4. The document is signed by the auditor and the project team to confirm this timeline (last page)
・Operational Communication Channels and Project Management Tools: Screenshots of the communication channels showing active participation are provided in Section 5

The audit agreement report is publicly and permanently accessible through this link on GitHub: https://github.com/OpShin/OpshinAudit/blob/main/Audit%20Agreement%20-%20Milestone%201.pdf

ms.promise: The audit team will compile a detailed analysis report identifying vulnerabilities and areas for improvement in OpShin language codebase. This analysis is more high level and can be supported by automated analysis tools, unit tests and manual assessments.
ms.criteria:
・Completion and Submission of Analysis Report: The detailed analysis report is completed and submitted, including the following:
・Quantitative Metrics: Number of vulnerabilities found (categorized by severity: critical, high, medium, low). 
・Code Coverage Percentage: Percentage of code covered by unit tests
・Number of Manual Review Findings: Total count of manual review findings, categorized by type (e.g., security, performance, maintainability).
・Recommendations for Improvements: A list of prioritized recommendations based on the findings, with a clear plan for addressing critical issues.
ms.report:
The audit has now been completed. An extensive document, outlining the project, code coverage, some qualitative analysis and a number of discovered performance and correctness issues with rectification recommendations are presented in this report on GitHub:
https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/opshin-audit/blob/4bd754e7c1d3f020864fd85de940dc15d787b493/catalyst_docs/milestone2/milestone2_langanalysis.md
The OpShin team has proofread these submissions and acknowledges them as significant, elaborate and well-founded.

ms.promise: The audit team compiles a documented list of edge cases relevant to OpShin smart contract development. They also propose strategies for resolving identified cases that can be applied to future iterations of the language. The work will be conducted mostly manually, accompanied with tailored analysis tools.
ms.criteria:
・Quantification of Edge Cases: The list includes a specified number of edge cases (e.g., a minimum of 5 unique edge cases), each thoroughly described and categorized.
・Validation by Development: The list of edge cases and proposed resolutions is reviewed and validated by OpShin team
ms.report:
Milestone 3 now has been successfully completed. Attached is a link to the edge-case document, outlining 9 unique edge-cases (exceeding the minimum of 5 documented in the acceptance criteria), including detailed test cases and resolution suggestions, and reviewed by the OpShin team.

This fulfills both acceptance criteria:
・The list includes at least the specified number of edge cases
・The list was validated by the OpShin team

https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/opshin-audit/blob/milestone3-progress/catalyst_docs/milestone3/milestone3-edgecases.md

ms.promise:
The audit team compiles a comprehensive audit report detailing identified vulnerabilities, recommended fixes, and best practices for OpShin development.

Meanwhile, the OpShin team works on described issues and integrates feedback on them into the codebase, adds their approval for the reported issues and feedback for the final report.
ms.criteria:
Completion of Audit Report: The audit report is completed and includes:
・Quantitative Breakdown of Vulnerabilities: All vulnerabilities identified, with each categorized by severity.
・Detailed Recommendations: A specific fix or mitigation strategy provided for each identified vulnerability.
・Incorporation of Best Practices: Best practice recommendations relevant to OpShin development.

OpShin Team Feedback and Integration:
・Feedback Collection: Written feedback from the OpShin team is collected and added to the report.
・Codebase Integration: Evidence that the OpShin team has addressed all crit
ms.report:
In this milestone we release the final milestone report draft and fix the critical issues reported. Please find our concrete outputs for the milestone below:

Draft audit report

The draft audit report was compiled by Anastasia Labs and publicly released in the opshin-audit repository. It is annotated with the response from the OpShin team for each reported issue.
https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/opshin-audit/blob/milestone4-progress/catalyst_docs/milestone4/milestone4-draft-audit-report.pdf

Bugfixes of High Severity and Critical Reported Bugs

The OpShin Team addressed all the High Severity and Critical findings in the audit and submitted Pull Requests to resolve them. They are tagged with audit v1 and shown in the public OpShin repository as follows:
https://github.com/OpShin/opshin/pulls?q=is%3Apr+label%3A%22audit+v1%22

The complete list of High Severity and Critical findings and their resolution status with more detailed commentary from the team is shown in this sheet:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1PU1EwOGX58f5BgJM3NxUvrZmagzjX7m62vHueSp64Qo/edit?usp=sharing

ms.promise:
・Public dissemination of the finalized audit report, including presentation of findings and recommendations to the Cardano community.

・Final closeout video
ms.criteria:
Dissemination of Audit Report:
・Publication: The audit report is published on at least three relevant platforms, including the official Cardano forum, GitHub, and a widely-used blockchain community blog (e.g., Medium).
・Community Engagement: The audit findings are presented at on Twitter
・Social Media Metrics: The report’s publication is announced on social media channels, aiming for at least 100 engagements (likes, shares, comments) across platforms like Twitter and LinkedIn.

Resolution of Findings:

ms.report:
We have successfully completed the OpShin audit:
The latest release contains all suggested bug fixes, or documentation of the bugs and a short comment about how the issue was addressed inside the audit report.
OpShin Release: https://github.com/OpShin/opshin/releases/tag/0.25.0
OpShin Audit Report: https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/opshin-audit/blob/milestone5-progress/catalyst_docs/milestone5/milestone5-final-audit-report.pdf
We shared the audit update on the main OpShin communication channels
Twitter: https://x.com/OpShinDev/status/1974011626186498538
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/CardanoDevelopers/comments/1nwsm8e/opshin_audit_concluded_release_0250/
Across all these posts we have gathered over 130 likes, 10 comments and 40 reposts, demonstrating signficant interest from the community and exceeding our goals of 100 engagements.
All changes are merged into the latest release
Link to Pull Requests: https://github.com/OpShin/opshin/pulls?q=is%3Apr+label%3A%22audit+v1%22+
Note that many more changes were directly pushed to dev. A complete list of changes is documented in the final audit report: https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/opshin-audit/blob/milestone5-progress/catalyst_docs/milestone5/milestone5-final-audit-report.pdf
The closeout report and video are completed
Link to final closeout Report: https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/project-close-out-reports/blob/d1ebcfbc2ca88efadae87c163dac8ab03a1bcbbf/f12-opshin-audit-closeout-report/opshin-close-out-report.pdf
Link to final closeout Video: https://youtu.be/dQzK5gSLOxU
